title: Targeting RNA:protein interactions with an integrative approach leads to the identification of potent YBX1 inhibitors.
authors: El Hage, Krystel; Babault, Nicolas; Maciejak, Olek; Desforges, Benedicte; Craveur, Pierrick; Steiner, Emilie; Rengifo-Gonzalez, Juan Carlos; Henrie, Helene; Clement, Marie-Jeanne; Joshi, Vandana; Bouhss, Ahmed; Wang, Liya; Bauvais, Cyril; Pastre, David
one_liner_zh: 该文开发整合计算与实验的筛选方法靶向RNA-蛋白互作并发现YBX1抑制剂，虽涉及分子动力学模拟和结合干扰，但核心是RNA-蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: RNA-protein interactions (RPIs) are promising targets for developing new molecules of therapeutic interest. Nevertheless, challenges arise from the lack of methods and feedback between computational and experimental techniques during the drug discovery process. Here, we tackle these challenges by developing a drug screening approach that integrates chemical, structural and cellular data from both advanced computational techniques and a method to score RPIs in cells for the development of small RPI inhibitors; and we demonstrate its robustness by targeting Y-box binding protein 1 (YB-1), a messenger RNA-binding protein involved in cancer progression and resistance to chemotherapy. This approach led to the identification of 22 hits validated by molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy of which 11 were found to significantly interfere with the binding of messenger RNA (mRNA) to YB-1 in cells. One of our leads is an FDA-approved poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase 1 (PARP-1) inhibitor. This work shows the potential of our integrative approach and paves the way for the rational development of RPI inhibitors.
abstract_zh: RNA-蛋白质相互作用（RPIs）是开发具有治疗价值的新分子的有前景靶点。然而，挑战源于在药物发现过程中，计算方法与实验技术之间缺乏方法及反馈机制。在此，我们通过开发一种药物筛选方法应对这些挑战，该方法整合了来自先进计算技术的化学、结构和细胞数据，以及一种在细胞中对RPIs进行评分的方法，用于开发小分子RPI抑制剂；并通过靶向Y-box结合蛋白1（YB-1）——一种参与癌症进展和化疗耐药的信使RNA结合蛋白——证明了该方法的稳健性。该方法识别出22个命中物，经分子动力学（MD）模拟和核磁共振（NMR）波谱验证，其中11个被发现在细胞中显著干扰信使RNA（mRNA）与YB-1的结合。我们的一个先导化合物是FDA批准的聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶1（PARP-1）抑制剂。这项工作展示了我们整合方法的潜力，并为RPI抑制剂的合理开发铺平了道路。
